title: 2x2 calibration session on AerSimulator.from_backend(FakeFez) [local testing mode]: decoder validity, bit order, yield versus CZ count, readout confusion, Ritz consistency

criteria.name: decoder validity: accepted strings that re-encode to themselves
B=0: acceptance of random bit strings (exhaustive over 4096 strings)
B=1: acceptance of random bit strings (exhaustive over 4096 strings)
B=0 r=1 (663 CZ): measured f = 0.1710 vs the predicted f = 0.1727 (both from y = 0.82 f + (1-f) a inverted at a = 0.00928)
B=1 r=1 (663 CZ): measured f = 0.1571 vs the predicted f = 0.1600 (both from y = 0.82 f + (1-f) a inverted at a = 0.00488)
B=0: decoded support reproduces the exact E0 = -3.6408 (support 38 decoded + references = 38 of the 38-dimensional sector: saturated)
B=1: decoded support reproduces the exact E0 = -1.8616 (support 20 decoded + references = 20 of the 20-dimensional sector: saturated)
readout confusion on 3 patch(es): smallest diagonal element
readout error per qubit against the frozen calibration snapshot (worst ratio; on a real device this is the calibration-drift item)

sampler_options.error_mitigation: none: SamplerV2 returns raw bit strings; no resilience level, no readout mitigation of expectation values (prompts/07 step 2)

data.prediction_source: the simulated yield of validation/H0P.json (gate H0P, 2026-09-16 13:15:46 MDT), the preregistered prediction of reports/H0_prereg_draft.md

yield_model_inputs.formula: y = 0.82 f + (1-f) a  (manual Step 4.4, both terms)
yield_model_inputs.garbage_acceptance_source: exhaustive: all 2^n bit strings through skqd.codec.Codec.decode for the target sector
yield_model_inputs.note: the 30 % criterion is on f; the shot plan keeps using the clean yield 0.82 f, since garbage acceptances add no support

clean_statistic.statistic: clean_fraction_mixture (decision C2') and reference_string_test (decision C3'); the near-clean term is the residual of the amended Step-4.4 model (decision M4.4)
clean_statistic.decisions: C2' (the mixture estimator replaces the yield inversion), C3' (the reference-string count is the bit-order test), M4.4 (the yield model gains the near-clean acceptance term) -- data/H0_replan_owner_decisions.md, signed 2026-09-30
clean_statistic.criteria_note: no criterion of this gate reads these tables; criterion 2 is still the 30 % test on the yield-inverted f of `f_comparison`, so every committed value is reproduced
